assets.name: multi-agent-protocol
assets.text: Coordinate multi-agent, cross-session, and cross-device tasks via Git-Native single-file task capsules (.tasks/<id>.md) with TTL leases, PreToolUse scope guards, and verify_cmd gates. Triggers: task capsule, multi-agent collaboration, task board, agent handoff, task dispatch, cross-agent sync. Do not use: real-time communication (use WebSocket), real-time whiteboard.

assets.name: oss-absorb
assets.text: Evaluate, security-audit, and distill external open-source GitHub repositories or paper mechanisms into EngineerRig. Triggers: absorb open source, evaluate github repo, extract oss skill, distill repo, oss-absorb. Do not use: tweaking internal scripts, running existing assets.

assets.name: session-close
assets.text: Run atomic session-close verification (_meta/session_close.py), record structured retro, verify skill links and git sync status until exit code 0. Triggers: close session, wrap up, finish session, pre-close check, session-close, session_close. Do not use: mid-task pause when work is still in progress.
